about: Surf Saunton teaches surfing on the three-mile beach at Saunton Sands in north Devon. It runs group lessons split by experience level and private lessons for all ages. Beginners start with a short safety talk on the beach before going in the water.
offers: All ages; under-8s need a parent in the water or a private lesson
where: Saunton Sands beach, with a large car park, toilets and indoor changing nearby
goodToKnow: Board and wetsuit included; boots and gloves depending on season
Bring swimwear, sun cream and a towel
Arrive 20 minutes early; lessons at 10.30am and 1.30pm
gaps: No accreditation, season or cancellation terms stated.
